HarmonyOS Build Run Diagnose Skill

四步完成一次鸿蒙构建诊断演练

从三份示例日志出发，定位四处源码问题，完成修改、工具自检和缓存清理，最后把项目与验证记录一起交付。适合接触仓颉鸿蒙开发、需要看清报错与修复过程的开发者。

00

开始前，只准备这三样

01

完整 Skill 包

在 Finch 产品页登录后获取 HarmonyOS Build Run Diagnose，保留完整目录与工具文件。

02

练习项目 test.zip

本文已附测试材料。里面有待办项目、三份人工诊断样例和五处测试缓存。

03

可执行工具的 Agent

使用能读取附件、操作项目文件并执行命令的编码 Agent，准备 Python 3.11 或以上版本。

在 Finch 获取 Skill ↗下载练习材料 test.zip ↓
本次演练范围

这里演示日志诊断、源码静态修复、工具自检和缓存清理。示例日志是人工练习输入。应用编译与 HAP 打包属于后续验证，需要兼容的 DevEco Studio 和仓颉 / HarmonyOS SDK。

查看官网获取入口
01

分析日志，找准要改的地方

新开一个聊天，将完整 Skill 包和 test.zip 一起拖入。若宿主不支持直接处理 ZIP，先解压后提供两个完整文件夹。发送下方提示，让 Agent 读取 Skill 并实际调用日志分析工具。

发送这条 Prompt

用我拖入的 Skill 做离线诊断，分析这个项目的三份示例日志，指出问题和对应的源码位置。

运行后检查

看到三份日志各自的分析结果：四处源码问题均指向 index.cj；缓存样例单独解释。只读完说明文件，还不算完成这一步。

02

改四处代码，跑一次工具自检

继续使用同一聊天和上一轮项目，不用再拖文件。请 Agent 在项目副本中做最小修改，并运行 Skill 自带的单元测试。

发送这条 Prompt

修复刚才定位到的源码问题，给我修改前后的对比，并运行 Skill 自带的测试。

运行后检查

核对 size、trimAscii()、append() 和 margin(left: 4.vp) 四处修改。本次截图显示 24 项工具测试通过；这项结果与应用编译状态分别记录。

03

清理缓存，把源码完整留下

继续使用修复后的项目，调用仅清理缓存的流程。把源码和配置文件在清理前后的内容做比较，确认删除范围准确。

发送这条 Prompt

清理这个测试项目的构建缓存，核对清理前后的源码和配置是否完整。

运行后检查

本次删除五处测试缓存，清理前后 34 个非缓存文件哈希一致，源码、配置和示例日志均保留。

04

把项目和依据一起交付

让 Agent 整理修复后的工程、诊断输出、代码差异和测试记录。把本轮观察到的结论写进 Evolution.md，方便下次接续。

发送这条 Prompt

整理修复后的项目、诊断报告和验证记录，把已验证的结论写入 Evolution.md。

运行后检查

打开项目与记录，确认四处修改、24 项工具测试、五处缓存清理和 34 个文件校验都有依据；编译状态写清楚。

05

交付时，一眼看清三类成果

01

项目

保留修复后的源文件、配置与示例输入，后续可接入完整构建环境。

02

诊断与对比

用报告说明问题对应哪段代码，用差异文件说明实际改了什么。

03

验证记录

把工具测试、文件哈希和经验记录放在一起，支持下一位开发者复核。

4处源码问题定位
24项工具自检通过
5处测试缓存清理
34个非缓存文件保留

上方数字来自本次离线诊断演练；其中工具自检验证的是 Skill 工具。

06

遇到问题，就这样继续

没有出现日志分析结果

请 Agent 确认已解压完整 Skill 和 test.zip，并实际执行随包的日志分析工具。

缓存已经为空

为重复演练重新解压 test.zip；正常项目没有缓存时如实记录。

工具自检通过，应用是否也能运行？

两项结果分开判断。后续在兼容工具链中编译，并核验生成的 HAP。

发送这条 Prompt

只修复刚才检查中发现的问题，保留原项目，并重新核对受影响的文件。

继续使用时，可以换成自己的构建日志复用诊断流程；也可以清理另一个测试项目，或把已验证经验带到下一轮。每次更换输入后，都重新核对文件位置与验证范围。

INSTRUCTION · PRACTICAL GUIDE

HarmonyOS Build Run Diagnose Skill

A four-step build diagnosis walkthrough

Start with three example logs, locate four source issues, apply focused corrections, run the tool tests and clean project caches. Finish with a repaired project and an inspectable verification record. Designed for developers working with Cangjie HarmonyOS projects.

00

Before you start: three essentials

01

The complete Skill package

Sign in on the Finch product page and obtain HarmonyOS Build Run Diagnose. Keep its full directory and packaged tools.

02

The test.zip exercise

Download the included exercise. It contains a todo project, three authored diagnostic examples and five disposable cache targets.

03

An agent with tool access

Use a coding agent that can read attachments, work with project files and run commands. Python 3.11 or later is required.

Get the Skill on Finch ↗Download test.zip ↓
Exercise scope

This walkthrough covers log diagnosis, source corrections reviewed statically, tool tests and cache cleanup. The logs are authored exercise inputs. App compilation and HAP packaging are separate follow-up checks requiring compatible DevEco Studio and Cangjie / HarmonyOS SDKs.

View the official acquisition entry
01

Find the source locations behind the logs

Start a new chat and attach the complete Skill package together with test.zip. If your agent cannot process ZIP files directly, extract them and provide both complete folders. Send the prompt below so the agent reads the Skill and runs its log analyzer.

Send this prompt

Use the attached Skill to analyze this project's three example logs offline. Identify the issues and the relevant source locations.

Check the result

Look for a separate analysis of all three logs: four source findings point to index.cj, while the cache example is explained separately. Reading the instructions alone does not complete this step.

02

Apply four corrections and run the tool tests

Continue in the same chat with the same project; no new attachments are needed. Ask the agent to apply minimal corrections in a project copy and run the Skill’s included unit tests.

Send this prompt

Fix the source issues you identified, show me the changes, and run the Skill's included tests.

Check the result

Review the changes to size, trimAscii(), append() and margin(left: 4.vp). The captured run passed 24 tool tests; record that result separately from app compilation.

03

Clear caches while preserving project files

Continue with the repaired project and use the cache-only cleanup workflow. Compare source and configuration contents before and after cleanup to verify the deletion scope.

Send this prompt

Clean this test project's build caches and verify that its source code and configuration remain intact.

Check the result

The captured run removed five exercise cache targets. All 34 non-cache files retained identical hashes, including source, configuration and example logs.

04

Deliver the project with its evidence

Ask the agent to collect the repaired project, diagnostic outputs, source diff and test records. Save observed findings in Evolution.md so the next session can pick up with evidence.

Send this prompt

Package the repaired project, diagnostic report, and verification records. Record the verified findings in Evolution.md.

Check the result

Open the project and records. Confirm evidence for the four source edits, 24 tool tests, five cache removals and 34 preserved files, with compilation status stated separately.

05

Know what is in the handoff

01

The project

Keep the corrected sources, configuration and example inputs for a later build with the full toolchain.

02

Diagnostics and diff

Use the report to connect findings to code and the diff to show exactly what changed.

03

Verification records

Collect tool test results, file hashes and observed lessons for the next developer to inspect.

4source issues located
24tool tests passed
5cache targets cleaned
34non-cache files preserved

These figures come from the captured offline exercise. The unit tests validate the Skill’s tools.

06

Keep moving when a check needs attention

No log analysis appeared

Ask the agent to confirm both packages are fully extracted and actually execute the packaged log analyzer.

The cache is already empty

Extract a fresh test.zip for another exercise. In a normal project, record an empty cache accurately.

Do passing tool tests prove the app runs?

Track these as separate checks. Compile later with a compatible toolchain and verify the generated HAP.

Send this prompt

Fix only the issues found in the last check, preserve the original project, and recheck the affected files.

Next, reuse the workflow with your own build logs, clean another test project, or carry verified findings into the next session. When inputs change, recheck file locations and the scope of verification.
